title: Safe two-output gripper actuation
evidence: Mocked gripper tests verify DO0-open/DO1-close pulse order and all-low reset.

title: Gripper interlock and timing tests
evidence: 6 gripper unit tests passed; Python compilation passed.

title: Touch the board without ending the turn
user_visible_behavior: so that harmless interaction does not trigger the AI
verification_command: Accepted when hand/object entry and exit with a final board equivalent to the committed board produces no move and returns to PLAYER_IDLE.

title: Return a moved piece to its original square
user_visible_behavior: so that changing my mind does not end the turn
verification_command: Accepted when all intermediate observations remain transient and the restored final board produces no commit.

title: Hold a Red piece outside the board while thinking
user_visible_behavior: so that a lifted piece is not treated as captured, lost, or moved
verification_command: Accepted when disappearance during occlusion never mutates the committed board and never starts the AI turn.

title: Restore a held piece to its original square
user_visible_behavior: so that I can continue the same turn
verification_command: Accepted when a clear settled board equal to the committed board returns to PLAYER_IDLE without a commit.

title: Complete a legal move after holding a piece
user_visible_behavior: so that the turn ends only after the board is clear and stable
verification_command: Accepted when exactly one legal Red successor remains stable for the configured window and commits exactly once.

title: Block confirmation while the board is obstructed
user_visible_behavior: so that the AI never starts while a hand, tool, sleeve, or object remains over the board
verification_command: Accepted when interaction, occlusion, motion, or insufficient visibility has priority over candidate stability and blocks confirmation.

title: Detect a legal move without a hand event
user_visible_behavior: so that tools or missed hand detections can still complete the turn
verification_command: Accepted when a unique legal successor is committed after the longer no-interaction stability window.

title: Keep the player turn on invalid or incomplete boards
user_visible_behavior: so that missing pieces, illegal layouts, and ambiguity never start the AI
verification_command: Accepted when incomplete, illegal, missing-piece, and ambiguous observations never commit and enter a recoverable waiting state.

title: Commit each physical move at most once
user_visible_behavior: so that hand, stability, SPACE, and mouse evidence cannot double-commit
verification_command: Accepted when all evidence feeds one arbiter and stale, duplicate, or consumed turn/baseline tokens are rejected.

title: Diagnose player-turn state transitions
user_visible_behavior: so that camera and physical-board failures can be tuned and reproduced
verification_command: Accepted when logs expose state, event, candidate, confidence, tokens, timers, and rejection or recovery reason.

title: Retain manual SPACE and supervised correction
user_visible_behavior: so that the operator can recover safely when automatic vision is uncertain
verification_command: Accepted when manual confirmation uses the same validation and atomic commit gate and recovery never silently advances the turn.

title: Truthful physical motion result and capture gate
user_visible_behavior: so that a failed robot move cannot advance the self-play board state
verification_command: Accepted when only an explicit successful motion result and required pre/capture/post board reconciliation can authorize a commit.

title: Independent Red and Black difficulty profiles
user_visible_behavior: so that each robot side can use its selected available strength without restarting the engine
verification_command: Accepted when Red and Black calls use their selected profiles without mutating the global AI difficulty.

title: Safe physical Robot-vs-Robot controller
user_visible_behavior: so that continuous and step-by-step matches serialize physical turns and fault safely
verification_command: Accepted when ten alternating turns have no overlap and either motion or verification failure creates zero commit for that move.

title: Robot-vs-Robot setup and safe ending controls
user_visible_behavior: so that an operator can select both profiles, cadence, next move, or end the match safely
verification_command: Accepted when End prevents any later dispatch and waits for in-flight motion and safe-home before cleanup or navigation.

title: Self-play verification and supervised arm readiness
user_visible_behavior: so that a real-arm run begins only after automated and step-mode safety gates pass
verification_command: Accepted when the full test suite passes and the supervised preflight, non-capture, capture, and End checks are recorded.
